metadata.content: Mexico City GP: Charles Leclerc dominates first practice from Kimi Antonelli as Ferrari show strong pace | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Mexico City GP: Charles Leclerc dominates first practice from Kimi Antonelli as Ferrari show strong pace Ferrari's Charles Leclerc put down a statement time in first practice to be more than half a second clear of the field, including Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli; watch every session of the Mexico City GP live on Sky Sports F1, with Friday's second practice at 10pm Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Friday 30 October 2026 20:05, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Ferrari's Charles Leclerc set the quickest lap time during the first practice session at the Mexico City GP Ferrari's Charles Leclerc was fastest from champion-elect Kimi Antonelli in first practice at the Mexico City Grand Prix. Leclerc was 0.659s quicker than Antonelli to underline the expectation that Ferrari will be strong at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez due to their small turbo working well at high altitude. Lewis Hamilton was fourth after a scruffy soft-tyre lap but will be buoyed by his team-mate's pace as Ferrari look to win only their third race of the season. You would be forgiven for wondering how much longer Michael Carrick will remain in the Manchester United dugout. A run of eight games without a win has left Carrick searching for answers, with the performances raising as many questions as the results. The energy and organisation of his interim spell last season has been replaced by a team struggling to find their identity. Chelsea away is next on Saturday. messages.text: How Suzuki has wowed Villa fans since replacing Martinez

metadata.summary: Aston Villa fans still sing about having the world's number one goalkeeper. But what started as a chant for Emiliano Martinez and morphed into defiant support for young Japanese goalkeeper Zion Suzuki has become something else. They actually believe it.
metadata.content: Zion Suzuki analysis: How Emi Martinez's Aston Villa replacement now looks like a potential upgrade given his range of skills | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Zion Suzuki analysis: How Emi Martinez's Aston Villa replacement now looks like a potential upgrade given his range of skills Adam Bate examines the numbers behind how goalkeeper Zion Suzuki has impressed everyone at Aston Villa since replacing Emiliano Martinez in the summer. Watch Aston Villa vs Fulham live on Saturday Night Football on Sky Sports Premier League; kick-off 8pm Adam Bate Football Features Writer @ghostgoal Friday 30 October 2026 15:16, UK Image: Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki as already made a big impression since joining from Italian club Parma Aston Villa fans still sing about having the world's number one goalkeeper. But what started as a chant for Emiliano Martinez and morphed into defiant support for young Japanese goalkeeper Zion Suzuki has become something else. They actually believe it. Suzuki has been superb since joining from Parma in the summer. Not only has Martinez not been as missed as many anticipated, there is growing optimism that in his 24-year-old replacement, Villa have a goalkeeper who has even more facets to his game. There have been some standout displays already. Suzuki was excellent in the win over Manchester City last time out, ending their 100-per-cent Premier League record under Enzo Maresca.
